founded_year_patterns.description: Companies in scaling phase, past startup stage but still growing

icp_sweet_spots.description: B2B SaaS companies in scaling phase
common_problems: Sales team scaled beyond founder-led sales
Need visibility as team grows (manager can't see rep activity)
Prior tool implementation failed or became too expensive
value_props: Scales with team without adding headcount
buying_triggers: VP Sales/CRO hired in last 12-18 months

icp_sweet_spots.description: Early-stage SaaS moving from founder-led to sales team
common_problems: Founder can't manually track all outreach
buying_triggers: Moving from manual outreach to systematic

icp_sweet_spots.description: Mid-market companies with established sales teams
common_problems: Existing tool too expensive or complex

icp_sweet_spots.description: CORE ICP - Nearly 60% of customer base in this range

universal_mechanisms: Amplify lean sales team capacity during growth inflection points without adding headcount
Provide manager visibility into rep activities as team scales beyond founder-led
Standardize and track high-volume outreach with Gmail-native, fast-implementation approach
Reduce coordination latency with integrated tooling (Salesforce + Gmail)
Replace expensive enterprise tools (Outreach, Salesloft) with cost-effective alternative
Enable rapid onboarding for new hires with template-driven standardization
Track outreach performance with analytics for data-driven iteration
Maintain deliverability and compliance as volume scales

key_insights.primary_buyer_pain: Capacity amplification during growth inflection - sales teams need to scale output without scaling headcount proportionally
real_customer_validated_buying_triggers: VP Sales/CRO hired in last 12-18 months (new leader evaluating stack)
Multiple SDR job postings (hiring velocity = budget unlocked)
Outbound volume requirements exceeded current tool capabilities
Tool stack fragmentation (using multiple point solutions that need integration)
Manager visibility gaps (can't see what reps are doing as team scales)
Competitive tool dissatisfaction (Outreach complexity, Salesloft cost, Yesware limitations)
Recent funding round (Series A/B/C provides budget for sales tools)
First sales team hires (moving from founder-led to systematic outbound)
key_insights.decision_making_style: Pragmatic, speed-oriented, favor ease-of-use and fast time-to-value over feature complexity
critical_success_factors: Gmail integration (85% of customers use Gmail/Google Workspace)
Team-wide visibility and tracking for managers

prospecting_signals.employee_band_priority: 51-200 employees (32.86% of base), 11-50 employees (26.43% of base)
prospecting_signals.industry_priority: Software Development (26.8%), Technology/Internet (7.5%), IT Services (5.7%), Financial Services (5.7%)
prospecting_signals.displacement_targets: Outreach, Salesloft, Groove, Yesware users showing dissatisfaction

tier_2_influencers_implementers.role: VP of Revenue Operations / VP of Rev Ops
tier_2_influencers_implementers.notes: Often drives evaluation process, strong technical influence

tier_2_influencers_implementers.role: Director of Revenue Operations / Director of Rev Ops

tier_3_execution_leaders.role: VP of Sales Development / VP of SDR
tier_3_execution_leaders.buying_authority: Champion, budget influence for SDR tools

tier_3_execution_leaders.role: Director of Sales Development / Director of SDR

tier_3_execution_leaders.notes: Strong signal only at companies 100+ employees

job_posting_signals.description: When companies post roles for decision-makers, they're likely in a buying cycle
high_intent_signals: First VP Sales hire (likely building sales stack from scratch)
New CRO within 90 days (stack reevaluation window)
VP/Dir Rev Ops + sales leadership hire together (tool evaluation in progress)
5+ sales roles open simultaneously (major scaling = budget unlocked)
Job description mentions 'sales stack' or 'sales tools' explicitly
moderate_intent_signals: Director Sales backfill at growth-stage company
SDR expansion (3+ roles) at established company
Rev Ops hire at Series B/C funded company

competitive_engagement_signals.description: People who engage with competitors are high-intent prospects
awareness_only_competitors: HubSpot Sales Hub (LOW priority - CRM suite, not overly concerned)
engagement_types: LinkedIn comments on competitor posts (questions = evaluation mode)
Twitter/X replies to competitors (pain points = switching opportunity)
displacement_opportunities: Groove users complaining about feature limitations
Any competitor users with deliverability complaints

thought_leader_monitoring.description: Track specific revenue role thought leaders (NOT general GTM)
what_to_monitor: Posts about sales process, outbound strategy, tech stack
Job change announcements (new role = buying cycle activation)
Pain points shared about current tools

market_focus.core_message: We focus on SALES because Mixmax is a sales execution platform
market_focus.primary_use_case: Sales teams (SDR, AE, CRO, Rev Ops) executing outbound at scale

competitive_strategy.main_goal: Take out Outreach, SalesLoft, and Groove
competitive_strategy.approach: Monitor their weaknesses, extract dissatisfied users, position Mixmax as simpler/faster/more affordable alternative
competitive_strategy.not_goal: Overly concerned with HubSpot or Lemlist (awareness only)
